Name: Sandy Haired Skater Sam - Updated
Author: jsandret
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Sandy Haired Skater Sam - Updated[/b] is an authorized update to the original [b]Sandy Haired Skater Sam[/b] mod by [b]xhotfish[/b], bringing the mod up to date with modern Stardew Valley.

This version preserves the original sandy-haired, skater-inspired redesign while updating and expanding Sam's artwork for his newer appearances, including Beach, Winter, and JojaMart.

Tested on [b]Windows and Linux[/b], with the mod designed as a platform-independent Content Patcher pack.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Vortex[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b] are installed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install normally through Vortex.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Manual installation[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI 4.4.0 or newer[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod.[/color][/*]
[*]Extract the SandySam folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility note:[/b] This mod replaces Sam's character and portrait assets through Content Patcher. Other mods that replace the same Sam assets may conflict with or override some or all of these changes[size=3] depen[/size]ding on their Content Patcher rules and load priority.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Updated Sandy Haired Skater Sam for modern Stardew Valley[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Complete normal, Beach, Winter, and JojaMart sprites and portraits[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Numerous artwork corrections and refinements[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Preserves xhotfish's original Sandy Sam design and style[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher based — no original game files are modified[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.14+[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.4.0+[/b][/*]
[*]Content Patcher [b]2.9.0+[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Note on AI Assistance[/size][/b]
[size=2]AI-assisted tools were used during development, primarily for QA testing and validation, including checking asset structure, sprite and portrait consistency, pixel transparency, packaging, and cross-platform compatibility. All artwork was created or manually edited by a human, and all AI-assisted analysis, code, and recommendations were thoroughly reviewed and validated by myself before inclusion in the final release. [/size]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to [b]xhotfish[/b], creator of the original [b]Sandy Haired Skater Sam[/b] mod.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
This update is inspired by and based on their original Sam concept, design, and artwork. Full credit for the original character redesign and artwork belongs to the original creator.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Sandy Haired Skater Sam - Updated is being released with xhotfish's explicit permission.[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
You can find the original mod here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2368]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2368[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Thank you to xhotfish for creating a version of Sam that I've enjoyed using for years, and for allowing me to update and share it with the Stardew Valley community.[/color]
